title: AnalyticalCardHeader
description: Fiori KPI card header with localized values, semantic trend and state, and NumericSideIndicator.

usage.summary: Summarize a primary KPI with supporting indicators above an analytical card.
useWhen: Show a main number, its trend and up to two supporting values.
Place the KPI header above a chart inside Card.

avoidWhen.when: Introduce content with a title, avatar or an independent action.
Display an isolated semantic number inside a table or form.
